vocabulary_note: verdict uses the closed T2 vocabulary as a status+diagnosis pair (same shape as the A3/A4 artefacts); this is the LIVE half of the Phase E named pkarr/relay URL survival check — the static half is the hermetic tripwire test default_pkarr_url_matches_iroh_upstream_const (pkarr_resolver.rs)
probe_env_note: the curl probe targets the prod constants directly (curl does not consult iroh env vars); relevance of IROH_FORCE_STAGING_RELAYS: a daemon running under that env would have iroh's n0_dns() select N0_DNS_PKARR_RELAY_STAGING instead of the prod URL probed here
method: curl DNS+TLS+HTTP probe from the dev node (Windows, residential WAN), --max-time 15; liveness criterion = name resolves + TLS handshake completes + the HTTP service answers (any protocol-level status)

pkarr_relay_prod.criterion: https://dns.iroh.link/pkarr (== iroh::address_lookup::N0_DNS_PKARR_RELAY_PROD, byte-identical to SBFB DEFAULT_PKARR_RELAY_URL) must resolve and answer at the pkarr protocol layer
pkarr_relay_prod.observed: GET /pkarr -> 404 in 0.195s (remote 49.13.207.244, bare route without a key); GET /pkarr/<malformed-z32-key> -> 400 in 0.129s — the pkarr handler is alive and validating keys, not a dead vhost

relay_fleet_prod_1_0.criterion: the four n0 relay hostnames shipped by vendored iroh-1.0.1 defaults.rs (auto-adopted by presets::N0, zero SBFB hardcode) must resolve and answer over HTTPS
relay_fleet_prod_1_0.note: the 0.98 fleet hostnames carried an iroh-canary label (*.relay.n0.iroh-canary.iroh.link, vendored iroh-0.98.2 defaults.rs) — the 1.0 fleet dropped it; SBFB picked the new set up automatically at the Phase B bump because it hardcodes no hostname: node.rs keeps the presets::N0 default relay set whenever relay_config::load_relay_map returns None

hermetic_anchors.static_tripwire: pkarr_resolver::tests::default_pkarr_url_matches_iroh_upstream_const (DEFAULT_PKARR_RELAY_URL == iroh::address_lookup::N0_DNS_PKARR_RELAY_PROD + Url parse + https scheme; catches upstream URL drift at the next bump)
hermetic_anchors.existing_pkarr_hermetic_suite: pkarr_resolver.rs label/parse/env tests (7 pre-existing tests, untouched by Phase E; the tripwire above is the 8th and the phase's +1 net)

residual_risk: a live probe is a point-in-time fact — silent discovery death remains warn-only inside iroh (no SBFB health signal); routed to Phase G (THREAT_MODEL availability-silence line) and PLAN B C8 lives in split E' with its calendar gates (2026-08-01 provision / 2026-08-25 fleet switch / 2026-09-15 plan B active; n0 0.x relay EOL 2026-09-30)
